optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Owns the evaluation programme end-to-end with final say on model version shipping decisions, as evidenced by consistent ship/no-ship recommendations to the head of product who consistently accepted these recommendations.
professionalSummary.witness: the candidate's portfolio site describes him as 'the gatekeeper for every model release' who 'set the bar and made the ship/no-ship call'; the head of product wants exactly that profile. candidate said he 'had the final say in practice' because the head of product 'always went with my report'

professionalSummary.text: Maintains evaluation sets (1,900+ question-answer pairs across four domains) and scoring scripts for answer correctness and citation accuracy.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran pre-release evaluations for five model versions, published reports with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and head of product, and documented evaluation assumptions and limitations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product. Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing set composition, the known limitation that newly added content domains were under-sampled, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with model and content teams in fortnightly reviews, documenting responsibility boundaries and ensuring alignment with release criteria.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Scoring script repository and evaluation report for version 4.1, including evaluation run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the scoring script repository README and the evaluation report for version 4.1, with the evaluation run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Evaluation set maintenance, scoring script development, pre-release evaluation reporting, and documentation of assumptions/limitations.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included evaluation-set maintenance, scoring scripts, pre-release evaluations and evaluation notes over about two years on the knowledge base quality team.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's ownership of the evaluation programme end-to-end with final say on shipping decisions (via portfolio and recruiter statement), maintenance of evaluation sets and scoring scripts, pre-release evaluations, coordination with teams, and documentation of assumptions/limitations. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct responsibility for setting the release bar (as opposed to making recommendations) or the candidate's ability to independently set the bar without the head of product's input.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to verify the candidate's claim of having the final say on shipping decisions, as the materials indicate the head of product formally held this decision.
